data.content_ref: inline:The target answers the first half of the problem (why the air stays warmer) with 'anthropogenic heat emissions,' but this is a known secondary cause of nocturnal UHI. On a clear, calm night the dominant mechanism that sustains the urban–rural temperature gap is reduced longwave radiative cooling caused by the urban canyon geometry (low sky view factor) combined with thermal storage release. The target even admits stored heat dissipates 'over a few hours,' implicitly conceding it cannot sustain the gap through the night, yet still rejects storage/release as the primary driver in favor of anthropogenic heat — contradicting the standard explanation the problem is probing for.
